note: City of Cozad campground in Muny Park, 1401 Ave O: a row of concrete back-in pads along the gravel lot by the ballfield, trees along the back, a big lawn and playground beside; swimming pool next door. Railroad tracks nearby. Tent area too. --Claude
summary: The City of Cozad's camping page and its Set Your Sites listing confirm 12 RV spaces at $25 a night, first come first served with pay-by-QR, 30/50 A and water at every site, a 14-night limit, a dump station and sites available all year (water and dump shut off after mid-October); all written. The directory-derived 50-ft max length is cleared. Website should be the city's page; the pin is ~195 m off at the park entrance.
